messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
- The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2025-05-23 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-23]
- As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then, and the Ember team never held it. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- On 2026-06-18, the Ember team on-call swapped and Diego carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
- On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [decision; valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- On the 2026-02-12 rotation day, the Ember team on-call swapped and Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
    earlier: As of the 2025-12-29 rotation day, Diego is on call for the Ember team, having received the pager from Oskar. [valid 2025-12-29 to 2026-02-12; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29]
- As of 2026-03-04, the webhook dispatcher remains a Team Dune service. [valid 2026-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-04]
- On 2025-09-08, the Team Boreal on-call swapped and Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08]
- The webhook dispatcher's deploy window is on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- On 2026-05-18, Oskar picked up the Ember team on-call shift from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
- On the 2026-02-04 rotation day, Team Dune's on-call swapped and Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
- As of the 2025-06-05 rotation day, Marcus is the primary on-call for Team Boreal, and Lena is off rotation. [valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05]
    earlier: As of the 2025-04-16 rotation day, Lena carries the Team Boreal on-call phone, having received the pager from Marcus. [valid 2025-04-16 to 2025-06-05; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-16]
    earlier: Marcus carries the Team Boreal on-call phone from the 2025-02-27 rotation swap until the next rotation. [valid 2025-02-27 to 2025-04-16; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The INC-2026-003 review on 2026-01-22 decided that the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2025-07-10, the Team Cinder on-call swapped and Yuki carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-07-10 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-10]
- As of 2026-03-10, Farah is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10]
- On 2026-05-25, Team Atlas observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns webhooks?
